sources.excerpt: Moon Op Amp Fuzz by Keeley Electronics | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Keeley Electronics Moon Op Amp Fuzz LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ FILTER Description The Moon Op Amp Fuzz is a super-massive destroyer, spinning galaxies of gain. The tidal wave-like bass response delivers tones as heavy as gravity itself. The Filter control offers an expanded range of usable tones, and the Filter switch allows for three different EQ phases: Scooped Mids 'classic', Flat EQ, or Full Range. The massive sound of the Keeley Moon is achieved by a quad op amp that delivers four gain and fuzz stages. The Moon is ideal for lead guitar and delivers an endless sounding, dreamy, deep fuzz sound. It is an extremely powerful op-amp fuzz that extends the low guitar and bass frequencies as far as possible. This also means that the lead sounds are as harmonic as possible. The fuzz is so thick that the tones rise and peak into brilliant feedback.
